svg.text: 连线颜色表示流程所属阶段

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: A 段 · 一个会话建 map · 建完就停，一张 ticket 都不亲手解

span.p: 判出范围的写一份

span.p: 有。建成新的 decision ticket

span.p: 没有

div.style: color: rgb(61, 100, 12) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 难以回退且有取舍的

span.p: 考察过但否掉的方向

span.p: 写进文档的术语

div.style: color: rgb(102, 27, 166) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 关掉，不转 Wiki

color: rgb(61, 100, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 其余可回退的决定，被 spec 正文吸收

div.style: color: rgb(154, 51, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 每份 spec 各开一个会话

div.style: color: rgb(156, 16, 73) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(156, 16, 73) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(156, 16, 73) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(156, 16, 73) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(156, 16, 73) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(156, 16, 73) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(61, 100, 12) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: spec 正文落盘

div.style: color: rgb(61, 100, 12) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 代码落地后转成一页

div.style: color: rgb(31, 41, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: AFK：mmw issue claim 认领，接着解，还在同一棵 worktree 里

div.style: color: rgb(154, 51, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: HITL：不认领，交回用户

div.style: color: rgb(61, 100, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 查清的当场关掉，答案写进结案评论

div.style: color: rgb(61, 100, 12) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 往 Decisions so far 追加一行

div.style: color: rgb(27, 44, 31) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: mmw-start 判定这是一个 effortCodex 绑定 App 已创建的 detached worktree用一个空提交记下用户原话

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 第一步，给 destination 命名。它固定了范围，所以最先定

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 第二步，广度优先横扫整个空间。每条线都碰一下，不在任何一条上扎深

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 横扫下来，还有说不清楚的部分吗？

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 建 map issue，打上 wayfinder:map 标签

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 已经能精确表述的问题，各建一张 decision ticket

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 第二遍补阻塞关系。issue 要先有编号，才能互相引用

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 派 research subagent，逐条判定报告，把验证过的事实写进对应 ticket 的评论

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 停，交回用户报 map 已经建好，说明怎么开会话认领链

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 读一遍 map，只看整体，不逐个打开 ticket

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: frontier 上还有 ticket 吗？

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 挑一张没有阻塞、也没人认领的

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 先指派给自己；Codex 从 map 分支创建独立 Worktree 任务并绑定任务分支

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 这张是哪一类？

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 把答案写成结案评论，然后关掉这张 ticket

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 这个决定难以回退，而且真有取舍吗？

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 回头改 map。新问题先建 ticket 再连阻塞关系，判出范围的直接关掉

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 这张解开之后，下一张出现在 frontier 上、没人认领吗？

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 那一张是 HITL 还是 AFK？按 wayfinder: 标签判

div.style: color: rgb(22, 32, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 这条链收尾：草稿 ADR 改成正式编号，交回分支、HEAD SHA 与基点 SHA；map 任务验证后集成

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 停，交回用户报这条链做完了，frontier 上还剩几张可以认领

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: grilling 类，要人在场。这是默认类型，一场最多 15 轮

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: prototype 类，要人在场。跑 mmw-prototype，一轮回答一个问题

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: research 类，人不用在场。只查当前这一个决定，答完就停

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: task 类。agent 自己做得了吗？

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 按 mmw-research 派 subagent

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 按 mmw-verifying-agent-output 逐条验证。每条关键断言都要有主 agent 能自己验证的出处

div.style: color: rgb(11, 42, 61) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 验证过的事实写进 ticket 评论，没查清的另起一节列出来

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 停，交回用户给一份精确的操作清单，等他做完再继续

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 把 map 上还没说清楚的条目，列给用户看

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 里面还有会挡住后续工作的吗？

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 把这个视角的决定按类型分开，各写各的落点

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 派生 spec。把已定的决定按「哪些能凑成一份独立做得下去的东西」分组，一组一份。这一步只分组，不重新讨论。每份建一张 issue 挂在 map 底下，不带 wayfinder: 标签，靠这个跟 decision ticket 区分

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 68) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 关掉 map

div.style: color: rgb(74, 30, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 停，交回用户报派生了哪几份 spec，各开一个会话去做

div.style: color: rgb(62, 15, 38) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Codex 从 map 分支创建这份 spec 的 Worktree 任务并绑定任务分支

div.style: color: rgb(62, 15, 38) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: mmw-to-spec 综合成 spec，钉住 seam。用户点头通过 spec 定稿的人工审批关卡

div.style: color: rgb(62, 15, 38) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: mmw-to-tickets 切 tracer bullet
